ItemID: 1; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in accessories for my existing electronics than adding a voice assistant right now.
ItemID: 2; Title: SanDisk Ultra 16GB Class 10 SDHC UHS-I Memory Card up to 80MB/s (SDSDUNC-016G-GN6IN); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this as a spare for my camera, after checking its SDHC compatibility.
ItemID: 3; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I regularly use microSD cards, and the adapter makes this useful across my compatible devices.
ItemID: 4; Title: NETGEAR Wi-Fi Range Extender EX3700 - Coverage Up to 1000 Sq Ft and 15 Devices with AC750 Dual Band Wireless Signal Booster & Repeater (Up to 750Mbps Speed), and Compact Wall Plug Design; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current Wi-Fi coverage problem that would make me choose an extender.
ItemID: 5; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My power-strip purchases serve practical connection needs, and I am not currently looking for Alexa automation.
ItemID: 6; Title: SanDisk 64GB Ultra USB 3.0 Flash Drive - SDCZ48-064G-GAM46; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would use this to move photos and other files between devices alongside my memory-card reader.
ItemID: 7; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could complement my television, but I would check its connections and streaming support before choosing it.
ItemID: 8; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a tablet and do not currently need a dedicated smart display.
ItemID: 9; Title: SanDisk 32GB Ultra MicroSDHC UHS-I Memory Card with Adapter - 98MB/s, C10, U1, Full HD, A1, Micro SD Card - SDSQUAR-032G-GN6MA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my recurring storage needs, but I would choose only one of the similar 32GB cards this time.
ItemID: 10; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A second screen built around Alexa does not address my current camera, storage, or accessory needs.
